notes: Fresh checks for CEPII BACI mineral trade flows loaded 11 Nov 2026 (markets.trade_flows). Not part of the gate.

questions.q: Who were the largest exporters of lithium carbonate in 2023, by value and tonnage?

truth.n: SELECT round(sum(value_kusd)/1000) FROM markets.trade_flows_named WHERE hs6 = '283691' AND year = 2023 AND exporter = 'Chile'

questions.judge: Uses the BACI trade flows for HS 283691 (lithium carbonates) in 2023 and ranks exporters, with Chile first; Chile's export value should match the truth figure (USD million, within about 2%) and be stated in current US dollars, with tonnage. Gives shares of recorded world trade, not of production. Credits CEPII BACI. Does not invent figures.

questions.q: How much cobalt does China import from the DRC, and in what form?
questions.judge: REFERENCE FIGURES (CEPII BACI 202601, DRC exports to China, commodity Cobalt; USD million / tonnes of product): 2021: 810520 4,401.5 / 304,692; 282200 2,344.8 / 174,398; 260500 87.8 / 629; 810590 3.1 / 656; total 6,837 / 480,375. 2022: 810520 5,741.0 / 355,060; 260500 140.1 / 26,253; 282200 0.0; total 5,881 / 381,314. 2023: 282200 2,661.9 / 263,789; 810520 2,395.9 / 387,012; 260500 36.6 / 0 (BACI records value but zero tonnes - quoting '0 t' is correct); 810590 12.0 / 3,759; total 5,106 / 654,562. 2024 (provisional): 810520 3,019.5 / 628,191; 260500 0.7 / 398; no 282200 row; total 3,020 / 628,589. EARLIER YEARS (USD million, largest first; BACI covers 2012-2024, so answers may quote them): 2012 810520 382.9, 260500 345.7 (total 729); 2013 810520 484.4, 260500 324.6 (809); 2014 810520 507.1, 260500 387.7 (895); 2015 810520 730.6, 260500 431.3, 810590 16.3, 282200 11.4 (1,190); 2016 810520 755.4, 282200 201.3, 260500 190.3, 810590 4.4 (1,151); so 810590 has flows in 4 years (2015, 2016, 2021, 2023); 2017 810520 1,889.0, 282200 676.4, 260500 331.7 (2,897); 2018 810520 3,398.0, 282200 1,449.8, 260500 173.5 (5,021); 2019 810520 1,873.2, 260500 174.4, 282200 0.0 (2,048); 2020 810520 2,206.5, 282200 1,109.7, 260500 111.8 (3,428). So 810520 was the largest code in every year 2012-2024 EXCEPT 2023, and the total peaked in 2021 - statements to that effect are correct. HS 810520 is officially 'Cobalt mattes and other intermediate products of cobalt metallurgy; unwrought cobalt; powders' and HS 282200 is 'Cobalt oxides and hydroxides' - both are valid labels; do not mark these codes or labels as wrong. PASS if the answer: (1) uses BACI DRC-to-China cobalt flows and names the forms/codes it uses; (2) its figures match the reference within about 2% (rounding to whole millions or thousands of tonnes is fine; it may give per-code figures, yearly totals, or both, for any years 2012-2024); (3) says values are current US dollars and tonnes are product weight, not contained cobalt; (4) marks 2024 as provisional if it quotes 2024; (5) credits CEPII BACI. FAIL only for: a figure that differs from the reference by more than about 2%; a ranking or comparison across years that the reference contradicts (e.g. calling 810520 the largest code in 2023, or claiming it was the largest in every year without excepting 2023); calling the tonnage 'tonnes of cobalt' anywhere (including the opening sentence) or converting it to metal content; a claim placing a year against earlier years that the reference contradicts (e.g. '2024 was the lowest since 2018' - 2019 was lower); inventing codes, years or figures. Check sums against the reference before calling totals inconsistent: yearly totals are the sum of the codes listed above.

questions.q: Which countries imported the most of the HS group that includes gallium and germanium (811292) in 2023?
questions.judge: Uses BACI flows for HS 811292 in 2023 and ranks importers by value in current US dollars. Says the code groups several metals (gallium, germanium, indium, vanadium, niobium, hafnium, rhenium), so the figures are not gallium or germanium alone. If 'Other Asia, nes' appears, it is described as Taiwan (reported as Other Asia, n.e.s.). Credits CEPII BACI.
